`ai-artifacts/node-redesign/sources/5-status-open-loops.md`, summarising tool-ui-inventory `README.md`, `providers.md` and `tool-list.md`. Inspected 6 October 2026; Pi 1.0.0; agents2 `dceaa3f`; pi-extensions `6f66e2a`. No tidy-tools override was present during inspection. Package replacement removes the version-pinned patch, but the snapshot does not prove that caused its absence. `pi.getAllTools()` exposes names, schemas and source, not renderer hooks.
